name: Motorized Bicycle
description: Missouri's moped: a two- or three-wheeled device with an automatic transmission whose motor produces less than 3 gross brake horsepower (2,250 W) and can't propel it faster than 30 mph on level ground. It needs a licensed rider but no title or registration. Electric bicycles are excluded.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and an automatic transmission; pedals aren't required (Revised Statutes of Missouri §301.010)
Its motor produces less than 3 gross brake horsepower (2,250 W) and can't propel it faster than 30 mph on level ground (Revised Statutes of Missouri §301.010)
The definition also caps the motor's cylinder capacity at 50 cc, a gas-engine measure, and excludes electric bicycles by name rather than electric motors (Revised Statutes of Missouri §301.010)
Riders need a valid driver's license; no motorcycle endorsement (Revised Statutes of Missouri §307.195)
Not titled or registered with the Department of Revenue
Not allowed on interstate highways (Revised Statutes of Missouri §307.195)
